name: Custom Interlocking Acrylic Led Light
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:

 - Acrylic Panel: Made of premium clear acrylic, 1.5 cm (0.6 in) thick for excellent durability, stability, and a luxurious look.

 - Wooden LED Base: Crafted from solid pine wood, smooth polished finish, with a precision-cut slot to perfectly hold the acrylic panel.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:

   Each acrylic size comes with a proportionally fitted wooden base:

 - 5.9 x 5.9 inches ~ 15 x 15 cm → Wooden LED base: 15 x 4 x 3 cm / 5.9 x 1.57 x 1.18 in

 - 7.87 x 7.87 inches ~ 20 x 20 cm → Wooden LED base: 20 x 4 x 3 cm / 7.87 x 1.57 x 1.18 in

 - 10 x 10 inches ~ 25.4 x 25.4 cm → Wooden LED base: 25.4 x 4 x 3 cm / 10 x 1.57 x 1.18 in

 - 12 x 12 inches ~ 30.48 x 30.48 cm → Wooden LED base: 30.48 x 4 x 3 cm / 12 x 1.57 x 1.18 in

   Note: 

- The slot is designed to fit the 1.5 cm acrylic thickness tightly, keeping the panel firmly in place.

- The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:

 - Acrylic Panel: UV-printed on both sides, ensuring vivid colors and visibility from every angle.

 - Wooden Base: UV-printed on one side only, allowing space for custom text, logo, or decorative details.

 

  • Assembly & Usage:

 - Easy to assemble: Simply insert the acrylic piece into the wooden base, plug in the USB, and switch on.

 - USB powered, with switch options: monochrome light or 7-color changing light.

 - Soft LED light enhances the design and creates a warm, cozy atmosphere.

 - Perfect as a decorative piece for desks, shelves, nightstands, or festive displays.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:

A thoughtful and unique gift suitable for everyone on any occasion — from holidays like Halloween and Christmas to birthdays, anniversaries, and special celebrations.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging:1 x Custom Interlocking Acrylic Led Light

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

 

NOTE:

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
